items.title: i. Molecular mass and size: (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: i. Molecular mass and size:: a main subheading of 5.4.1 Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces (London dispersion forces), its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 99-99.

blocks.text: Compound ka molecular mass (Mᵣ) jitna zyada, id-id forces utni mazboot; aur mass kam to forces kamzor. Wajah: bare atom ya molecule ka electron cloud asani se phail aur khisak (polarise ho) jata hai. Yeh baat halogen aur noble gas families mein nazar aati hai. Halogen family mein upar se neeche size aur polarizability barhti hai, is liye physical state badalti hai: pehle do members (F₂ aur Cl₂) gas hain, bromine liquid aur iodine solid (b.p. = 458 K). Group 18 ki noble gases ke boiling points bhi helium (He) se xenon (Xe) tak barhte hain, jaisa Table 5.1 mein hai.
